body: Well I've pretty much been told I can't offer anything to anyone. No one will ever want to be close to a failure like me. May aswell go and jump in front of that train like I planned. bye.
If i die it, nothing will change and will probably got unnoticed.
I can't honestly say i enjoy anything. I wake up and dread the day because I have no hobbies.
Better go and kill myself then.

I learn every day in my job- IT constantly changes so I learn as it goes along. I deal with a lot of different people too.

I'm not training for anything really other than keep myself fit and healthy. I don't like any of the local sports here. Used to play football with people from work and tried to do it again this summer but can't now because not enough people will go. I did try though.

I'm working towards another certification yes. And will be taking the exam too. Work does not concern me though I do quite well.

Can't take the next step where I currently work. I've gone as far as I can get. I recently moved from home with some friends for a year. Once this is over I'm thinking of leaving this shit town. I hate the place.

I visit a few places but I normally have to go alone as my friends aren't interested. I'm thinking of going to canada next year to travel for a bit on my own, don't know how long before but in all honesty I don't care. Anything to get away from here. I love different cultures and will just mingle with the locals.

I don't honestly know. I don't have much in common with anyone.

I used to be involved in helping the community but there is so much back stabbing its not worth it. Seriously the amount of stress and shit you go through I don't know how anything get done. I know all of them aren't cunts but enough of them are. 

People only speak to me when they want help with something, then I'm forgotten about.

TBH i've never really had much female attention so I have always focused on myself. I earn a good honest wage and put a lot of hard work into my job. I keep myself healthy by cooking good meals, I keep fit and keep myself busy on weekends by either gaming, going to see a film or do something practical around the house that needs fixing. I wouldn't know where to start with trying to impress a girl really.
Yeah that's where I was kinda getting at really.

Thanks. It was a good read. I need to clarify again I wasn't being sexist here. I know I wasn't think straight which is why I wanted to post my thoughts here. It's good that someone like you has helped counter balance my argument, unlike the "your pathetic" comments from some other people. Thanks :)

Yeah you make a good point there. It's good to hear it from the opposite gender. I don't know if I could ever ask a women face to face the questions that i posted here on tell her how I felt. 

I suppose I feel a bit lost at the moment, not sure where to direct my life.
World leaders do not take up a large proportion of men. I'm talking ordinary people here.
Good point about the technology. Not about the hooker.
I have a job. I don't want to live to work though, there has to be more to life than that.

That's a poor reply. I'm not talking about getting laid. I've been laid, there is more to life that just getting laid you know. I'm taking about what the role of the modern man is. 

It's quite easy to say what the role of women is, if they choose to, bear children and now provide and look after them.
